[LLET.8.1] **`where` is pattern-attached.** A `where` clause
binds to the pattern it follows and reads that
pattern's bindings and an earlier pattern's ([LGRA.8.6]). A standalone rule-level `where` — one
outside any pattern, able to read `let` bindings — is a
**compile error** (`DS_PARSE_GENERIC`); `let` is not visible to any `where`
([LLET.10.4]).
